sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS backlog_documents FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id JOIN caseflow.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE d.reviewed_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'open' GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY t.team_name
explanation: The bank's backlog, documents waiting for an analyst, for each team.
